titles_native.title: 未来から来た 少年

description:
*From [INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/562-the-boy-from-the-future):*        
In the year 3015, humanity has suppressed emotions so that they may advance more efficiently. It is a world that has eliminated unnecessary values, forcing humans to live hollow lives.

A riveting story of a boy who lives in a desolate future and how he struggles with society!
